area: Sales by Tier and Sales by Category reports
title: How tiers and filters are labelled
stem: How should a tier be named in the rows, the Priced By filter and the downloads, and how should the Sales Type chip read?

options.t: As the reports PRD writes: an active tier as its number and name ("2 · Fleet"), an archived tier as its name with "(archived)", the same in the downloads, and the chip "Sales Type: All"
options.why: the reports PRD says its labels and messages ship as written

options.t: As the design draws: the tier's name only ("Tier 2"), no "(archived)", and a plain "Sales Type" chip

context: The reports PRD gives numbers, "(archived)" and "Sales Type: All". The design's pictures and its CSV picture show names only and a plain chip.
where: Sales by Tier and Sales by Category PRD, Stories 1, 3 and 4; Tiered Pricing design canvas, pictures 20.2 to 20.5, 20.9, 20.12, 20.13, 20.18, 20.20
